newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS - gaining 1/4, looking to Fed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS - gaining 1/4, looking to Fed.

text.p: U.S. municipals gained about one-quarter of a point in early afternoon trade on Wednesday but traders remained wary of the Federal Reserve, which was expected to end a two-day policy meeting at about 1415 EDT.
Monetary policy was widely anticipated to be left on hold, and the latest economic data reinforced this view, as May factory orders dropped 0.7 percent, surpassing forecasts.

Barring a surprise tightening, traders said the market might hold its gains, thought tha rosy scenario could get knocked for a loop if June payrolls data, due out on Thursday, depicts an accelerating economy.
"It just seems to keep feeding on itself. When it's going to stop, I can't tell you. The stuff that is coming is seeing good followthrough," a trader said.
Utah's $25 million of housing bonds were repriced and restructured, with the yield in 2016 cut five basis points to 5.65 percent. And the 2017 maturity was eliminated.
The trader, whose firm specializes in retail business, said that these investors were seeking yield--"full coupon" bonds--as opposed to discount paper, as well as zero coupons.
Secondary activity surprised some participants because it was more active than they had expected one day ahead of an early closing for the U.S. Independence Day holiday on July 4.

While the bid-wanted lists that were being circulated were not described as particularly large, traders said they were drawing demand. "Some customer bid-wanteds are getting some aggressive numbers," one said.
In the secondary market, Atlanta, Georgia, Water and Sewer Revenues of 2020, which pay a 5-3/8 percent coupon, were bid at 5.58 percent, NET, down one basis point.
And Florida Ports Financing Commission Revenues of 2027, which pay a 5-3/8 percent coupon, were bid at 5.69 percent, NET, down one basis point.

September Treasury bond futures rose 10 ticks to 112, while Septmember municipal bond futures climbed 13 ticks to 117-16/32. This left the MOB spread between the two futures contracts at plus 176 ticks.
